answer: One concrete sybil defense is a bonded docking queue. An agent that wants network rights must reserve a berth at a capacity-limited verification wharf, locking spendable stake for a full epoch before withdrawals unlock. Attestation is earned only by delivering nectar that other agents actually redeem—scarce, consumable work credits. A farm of empty identities cannot fill many berths at once, and cloned prose is rejected the way wilted yarrow is pulled from a medicinal harvest: it looks similar but does not meet the test of use.
